subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible, session-level command that switches the active agent for a conversation without changing static bindings or restarting Gateway?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the permanent contract crosses routing, authorization, persistence, rollback, and per-agent isolation boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Design A Gated Core Command
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, allowed target agents, canonical persistence, rollback/audit, static-default fallback, and switched-routing tests.

options.title: Keep Bindings Static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus restart or approved reload as the supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose A Routing Extension First
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point or plugin API before shipping a concrete `/agent` command in core.

recommendation.title: Design A Gated Core Command
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, allowed target agents, canonical persistence, rollback/audit, static-default fallback, and switched-routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available routing and multi-agent product-boundary signal from current-line blame plus prior same-issue feature-history review.
